t: What Floating Offshore Wind Platforms Is
title: What Floating Offshore Wind Platforms Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Floating wind puts turbines on floating platforms anchored in deep water — unlocking the 80% of offshore wind resource in waters too deep for fixed foundations, with steadier, stronger winds. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Floating Offshore Wind Platforms: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Floating Offshore Wind Platforms in one line: Floating wind puts turbines on floating platforms anchored in deep water — unlocking the 80% of offshore wind resource in waters too deep for fixed foundations, with steadier, stronger winds.
Why it matters: Deep water holds the best winds; floating platforms unlock them..
Where it is used: clean power, green hydrogen, deep-water grids..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
